responsibility: Defines the main PA-RISC target option table. It declares backend flags and variables for architecture level, scheduler CPU, assembler and linker assumptions, calling-convention variations, soft float and soft multiply, long calls/load-store sequences, memory-ordering behavior, atomic-libcall policy, and related compatibility switches, providing the generated option metadata that drives PA target flags consumed throughout pa.h, pa.cc, and pa.md.
same_name_distinction: PA option-table file: unlike pa.h, pa.cc, and pa.md, it exists to declare target switches, variables, and enums such as march, mschedule, msoft-float, and matomic-libcalls, not to define macros, backend algorithms, or RTL instruction patterns.
